texto:
The Miller family has a new smart speaker in their kitchen. They call it "Alex" and it is a helpful digital assistant. Every morning, Mr. Miller asks Alex for the weather forecast before he goes to work. During the day, Mrs. Miller uses it to listen to the radio or to find a new recipe for dinner. Their children, Tom and Lucy, enjoy asking Alex to tell them jokes or play their favorite songs. The smart speaker is a central part of their daily routine now.

Yesterday, for example, Lucy had a big school project. She asked Alex for facts about penguins, and it gave her a lot of useful information. Later, Tom used it to set a reminder for his soccer practice. Mrs. Miller thinks the technology is very convenient, but she also believes it's important for the family to talk to each other and not only to the machine. She wants to find a good balance.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what does Mr. Miller ask the smart speaker for every morning?
preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B. El texto dice explícitamente: 'Every morning, Mr. Miller asks Alex for the weather forecast before he goes to work' (Cada mañana, el Sr. Miller le pide a Alex el pronóstico del tiempo antes de ir a trabajar). The other options are incorrect because: A es lo que hacen los niños (play their favorite songs), C es lo que hace la Sra. Miller (find a new recipe), D es lo que hizo Lucy (asked... for facts about penguins), y E es lo que hizo Tom (set a reminder).

preguntas.pregunta: What can be inferred about Mrs. Miller's opinion on the smart speaker?

opciones.A: She thinks it is completely useless.
opciones.B: She wants to buy another smart speaker for the house.
opciones.C: She thinks it is useful but has some concerns.
opciones.D: She believes the technology is only for children.
opciones.E: She never uses the smart speaker herself.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C. Podemos inferir que tiene una opinión mixta: le parece útil pero tiene algunas preocupaciones. El texto dice: 'Mrs. Miller thinks the technology is very convenient, but she also believes it's important for the family to talk to each other... She wants to find a good balance'. La palabra 'convenient' (conveniente) muestra que lo ve útil, pero la palabra 'but' (pero) y su deseo de un 'balance' (equilibrio) indican que también tiene preocupaciones. The other options are incorrect: A es falsa porque lo considera 'convenient'. B no se menciona en el texto. D es falsa, ya que ella misma lo usa. E también es falsa, porque el texto dice que lo usa 'to listen to the radio or to find a new recipe'.
